description: Source code for an Android live wallpaper that renders a rotating wireframe cube with user-selectable shapes, including model loading, touch interaction, and animation.

classes.name: ThreeDPoint
classes.description: Represents a point in 3D space with x, y, z coordinates.

classes.name: ThreeDLine
classes.description: Represents a line in 3D space defined by start and end point indices.

classes.name: CubeWallpaper2
classes.description: An Android WallpaperService that displays a rotating wireframe cube with user-selectable shapes.

classes.name: CubeEngine
classes.description: Inner class handling the rendering, user interaction, and shape model management for the live wallpaper.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when service is destroyed.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns the engine responsible for rendering the wallpaper.

methods.name: onSharedPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when user preferences change, particularly the shape model.

methods.name: readModel
methods.description: Loads shape model data (points and lines) from resources based on selected shape.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes callbacks when engine is destroyed.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Starts or stops animation based on wallpaper visibility.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Updates center coordinates when surface size changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Handles surface destruction and stops animation.

methods.name: onOffsetsChanged
methods.description: Updates animation based on user offset changes.

methods.name: drawFrame
methods.description: Draws a single frame of the animation, scheduling next frame.

methods.name: drawCube
methods.description: Handles cube rotation, projection, and drawing.

methods.name: rotateAndProjectPoints
methods.description: Applies rotation transformations and projects 3D points onto 2D plane.

methods.name: drawLines
methods.description: Draws lines between projected points to form wireframe.

methods.name: drawTouchPoint
methods.description: Draws a circle at the last touch position.
